name: Stames Floating Widget
author: Gideon Koney

sections.description:
In today’s digital world, businesses are overwhelmed with messages from multiple platforms—WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Emails, Contact Forms, and more. The challenge? Messages get lost, customer data is scattered, and sales opportunities slip through the cracks. That’s where Stames comes in.

Stames is a cutting-edge 360° SaaS communication and automation platform designed to help businesses centralize, track, and streamline their customer interactions. Unlike traditional CRM systems that focus only on contact storage, Stames provides a real-time, multi-platform communication hub that helps businesses close sales faster, provide better customer support, and enhance team collaboration.

To further enhance customer engagement, Stames offers the Floating Widget—an easy-to-install web widget that allows visitors to instantly call, chat, or submit inquiries without leaving the website.

Two Widget Options:
🔘 Call-to-Action Widget – A floating button for instant communication via chat, call, or support requests.
🔘 One-Click Widget – A simple contact form that collects leads effortlessly.

By integrating the Stames Floating Widget, businesses can capture leads, provide better customer support, and increase conversions. Whether you’re in real estate, e-commerce, banking, hospitality, or customer service, Stames is designed to improve your customer engagement and sales processes.

Short Description

A floating widget for seamless customer interactions, powered by Stames. Supports call-to-action and one-click messaging.

Settings

  1. Go to Tools > Stames Widget.
  2. Enter your Stames Data Key (provided in your Stames subscription account, under Integration Settings).
  3. Select widget type (either One Click or Call To Action).
  4. Click Save Changes.
  5. The widget will now appear on your website, displaying the buttons.

Instructions

  1. Follow the steps in the plugin settings page to configure the widget.
  2. If you experience issues, ensure your Stames subscription account is active and the Data Key is correct.

Source Code

Unminified JavaScript and CSS files are available in the “/src” folder.

External Services

This plugin connects to external services provided by Stames Software (https://www.stamesoft.com) to enhance its functionality. Below are the details:

  • What it does: The plugin loads scripts from Stames to enable key features like form handling, pop-up modals, and real-time communication.
  • What data is sent: No personal data is sent. The scripts are only loaded for functionality.
  • Where the data is sent: Scripts are fetched from https://www.stamesoft.com but do not transmit user data back.
  • List of external scripts used:
    • https://www.stamesoft.com/assets/plugins/popper/umd/popper.min.js
    • https://www.stamesoft.com/vendor/jquery/jquery.min.js
    • https://www.stamesoft.com/assets/plugins/bootstrap/js/bootstrap.min.js
    • https://www.stamesoft.com/js/iframe_form.min.js
  • Terms and Privacy Policy: You can review Stames privacy policy here: https://www.stamesoft.com/support/documentation/?article=privacy-policy and Terms and Conditions here: https://www.stamesoft.com/support/documentation/?article=terms.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to your WordPress dashboard, and navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin, select the downloaded zip file, and click Install Now.
  4. Once installed, click Activate.
